messages:
maya (People Ops): thanks everyone for the all-hands questions — opening this thread to capture follow-ups on performance reviews, leveling, promos, comp and benefits. pls drop any clarifying Qs and we’ll triage. office hours Wed 2-3pm PST. quick notes: calibration closes end of day Friday, retro pay takes ~2 payroll cycles.

alex (Eng Manager): quick one — if a manager missed the calibration window, can we still flag an edge case?

jordan (VP, People): yes — short answer: yes for documented exceptions. please use the Exceptions form (link below) and cc your people partner. we’ll review urgency and business justification.

sam (SWE): what’s the easiest way for ICs to request a leveling re-eval? do managers need to file anything special?

maya (People Ops): IC -> talk to your manager first. manager can submit a Leveling Review request via the People Portal (https://redwood.internal/people-portal). include a 1-paragraph case + 2-3 evidence bullets (impact, scope, org complexity). we recommend managers attach latest peer feedback.

emily (Recruiter): follow-up for hiring teams — will offer bands change after calibration? thinking about open reqs and comp approvals.

carlos (Finance): bands are gated until calibration finalizes. you can still extend offers assuming current approved ranges, but note HR must re-run approvals if a candidate's target would exceed the finalized band. ping @emily for urgent pre-approval.

sam (SWE): any update on retroactive comp timing? mentioned ~2 pay cycles — is that guaranteed?

jordan (VP, People): retro pay is subject to payroll cutoffs and tax processing. target is two cycles but allow one extra for cross-border cases. we’ll include a timeline on the case confirmation email.

alex (Eng Manager): a manager asked about making an off-cycle promo effective earlier than the next cycle for retention — process?

maya (People Ops): off-cycle promos are allowed for urgency/retention. manager should submit the Off-cycle Promo form and select "Retention/Emergency" reason, attach manager approval and skip-level sign-off if possible. People Ops triages within 3 business days. note: comp approval + payroll deadlines still apply for effective date.

sam (SWE): is there a public rubric for leveling changes? i remember seeing a doc but couldn’t find it.

maya (People Ops): yes — Leveling Rubric v2 is live. link: https://redwood.internal/docs/leveling-rubric-v2. we added examples for T-shaped IC growth and cross-functional leads. feedback welcome — we’ll iterate.

emily (Recruiter): benefits Q — any change to parental leave or 401k matching next year?

jordan (VP, People): no immediate changes to parental leave. 401k matching review is scheduled with Finance next month — we’ll share any decisions in the benefits update doc and post a summary in #people-ops.

carlos (Finance): adding — if there are specific requests from teams (e.g., higher match thresholds for specific hires), put them in the finance-requests form and tag me.

sam (SWE): thanks — last one: appeals process if someone disagrees with calibration outcome?

maya (People Ops): appeals accepted within 10 business days of final calibration email. manager + IC should submit the Appeal form with supporting evidence. Appeals are reviewed by a cross-functional panel (People, two neutral managers, and one director). outcomes: uphold / revise / escalate. we’ll publish anonymized trends after the cycle.

alex (Eng Manager): can someone from People Ops join our skip-level sync to clarify a couple of edge cases?

maya (People Ops): yes, @alex — i can join a 30m slot. DM me preferred times and i’ll book.

jordan (VP, People): action items captured: 1) publish calibration FAQs doc by EOD Thu (maya) 2) update payroll timing note on retro pay (carlos + maya) 3) surface 401k review summary after Finance meeting (carlos) 4) run office hours Wed 2-3pm PST (maya + emily).

sam (SWE): appreciated, that helps.

hr-bot: Reminder — calibration survey closes Friday 23:59 PST. Please complete if you participated. :bell:

maya (People Ops): closing the thread for now — if you need 1:1 help, book via my calendar or open a People Ops ticket. i’ll post the FAQs link here when live. :sparkles:
